description: Makes a collection on the link page (no collection_id) or changes one: its title, an emoji, its products in order (link ids from links_list; up to 24; they needn't be on the page's list), its card (grid: the first 3 products' pictures; photo: cover_media_id), and whether it shows. New collections go last; bio_collections_reorder moves them. Undo puts the page back.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

program_id.description: The brand program it's for (brand_applications_list program_id)

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: bio_collection_save
title: Add or edit a collection
